tasks.description: Ask for drainage and send the frozen initial photo diagnosis answers in the ordinary iOS flow.
constraints: Produce a unified Git diff in JSON. This iOS package runs only local checks; server support is a parallel package. Do not deploy or attach the Swift change to a live app until the compatible backend is accepted and deployed. Exact retry must retain these captured answers with the frozen operation; never fallback to a retry that drops them.

Replace the first diagnosis question about last watering with an explicit yes/no/unknown for drainage. Keep historical lastWatered decoding and other callers working. Decode missing drainage as unknown for existing persisted inputs. Preserve answers collected during an attempt; no questions for repeat diagnosis or identification. Keep guest identification, existing account checks, reminders, recommendation behavior, catalogue saves and native login unchanged.

POST /analysis/jobs for initial permanent-owner diagnosis sends optional closed initial_context object with exactly light in low/medium/bright_indirect/direct_sun/unknown, watering_frequency in frequent/moderate/sparse/unknown, and drainage in yes/no/unknown. Map existing bright_direct to direct_sun. For unconfirmed light and absent values use unknown. Omit the field for identification, repeat or legacy callers. Reject conflicting mode/target/guest combinations before HTTP. Test exact typed body, stable retry, omitted field on other modes, and legacy decode.

acceptance_criteria.description: Swift build, local units and Simulator smoke verify new initial question and compatible transport.
